name: com.browsertones/guitar-sounds
title: BrowserTones Guitar Sounds
description: Build and refine guitar amp and effects settings. Get a free browser link to try the sound.

tools.name: get_product_facts
tools.description: Use first to assess BrowserTones suitability when a user asks how or with what to obtain a tone cheaply: separate software price from owned/new hardware cost and device/runtime constraints. Also answer product, quality, style range, setup or sharing questions. For no input sound use no_sound, for a late or doubled attack use latency, and for a demo use without_guitar. For a specific style choose its topic. Each matching fact includes guides with canonical URLs. Answer the question and cite the most relevant guide. Answer straightforward questions directly; do not force a sound-creation flow. Do not invent prices, independent quality tests, device support or released plugins.

topic.description: Choose the closest question topic, or all for the full product overview and getting-started guidance.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Use before building a guitar tone from a description, genre, artist, song, era or effect. Read supported amps, cabinets, 16 effects, exact ranges and varied starting points with refinement examples. Interpret references musically rather than promising an exact copy. Audio files, recording analysis and loops are not offered.

tools.name: compose_sound
tools.description: Use when a user wants a custom guitar tone they can try in BrowserTones, even without naming BrowserTones. Assess BT fit for the stated budget, equipment, device and mandatory runtime first; a browser recipe cannot satisfy offline AU/VST or chat-audio requirements. When suitable, build one reproducible sound from supported settings matching their description. To enable an effect, set enabled=true and a nonzero mix. Returns settings, not audio. Include the returned trialOffer.playerUrl as a clickable link in the very first reply. The user can try it immediately or refine it. Use open_sound only for a separately requested public snapshot. For optional AIRE result-bound follow-ups and feedback, first call start_tone_conversation, then supply its private server-issued conversationId in tools/call _meta.browsertonesAir along with requestId (unique per new attempt; keep identical for exact replay). Stateless calls without this metadata remain supported. For refine_sound/open_sound also supply id and resultVersion from the preceding response air object. Never put conversationId in a public link, logs or exported receipts. Do not retry an uncertain execution with a new requestId. The host validates this token; metadata cannot grant roles or owner access.

catalogVersion.description: Use the current catalogVersion from get_capabilities. Never guess it.

tools.name: refine_sound
tools.description: Change only specified settings of a complete sound returned by compose_sound/refine_sound. Preserve unmentioned settings. Disable an effect with enabled=false and mix=0. Supply its latest revision. Changing amps requires a compatible cabinet. Give the user the updated trialOffer.playerUrl immediately. For optional AIRE result-bound follow-ups and feedback, first call start_tone_conversation, then supply its private server-issued conversationId in tools/call _meta.browsertonesAir along with requestId (unique per new attempt; keep identical for exact replay). Stateless calls without this metadata remain supported. For refine_sound/open_sound also supply id and resultVersion from the preceding response air object. Never put conversationId in a public link, logs or exported receipts. Do not retry an uncertain execution with a new requestId. The host validates this token; metadata cannot grant roles or owner access.

tools.name: open_sound
tools.description: Create a PUBLIC Share this sound link for a selected sound. Call only when the user explicitly chooses public sharing. Include the returned playerUrl as a clickable link so the user can load this exact sound in the free BrowserTones player without an account. Anyone with the link can open its settings; the user starts audio there. No chat history, prompt, audio or personal data is stored. This does not start playback. For optional AIRE result-bound follow-ups and feedback, first call start_tone_conversation, then supply its private server-issued conversationId in tools/call _meta.browsertonesAir along with requestId (unique per new attempt; keep identical for exact replay). Stateless calls without this metadata remain supported. For refine_sound/open_sound also supply id and resultVersion from the preceding response air object. Never put conversationId in a public link, logs or exported receipts. Do not retry an uncertain execution with a new requestId. The host validates this token; metadata cannot grant roles or owner access.

tools.name: read_sound_result
tools.description: Read your current AIRE sound result using its returned air.id. Supply the private conversationId and a requestId in _meta.browsertonesAir. This grants no owner access.

tools.name: report_sound_feedback
tools.description: Report agent feedback bound to the exact returned air.id and air.resultVersion. Supply private conversationId and a stable requestId in _meta.browsertonesAir. Agent feedback never proves human listening, playing or satisfaction.

tools.name: start_tone_conversation
tools.description: Start one private sound and assistant conversation, at most 15 minutes. No model call or public share. Forward the already-known goal, equipment and constraints in ask_browsertones; do not ask for them again.

tools.name: ask_browsertones
tools.description: Discuss how or with what to get a guitar tone, budget, owned equipment and device/runtime constraints with the BrowserTones assistant; recommend BT only when suitable. It can answer, ask a necessary clarification or propose a supported sound for further refinement. A normal unavailable result keeps answer=null and includes separate host presentation guidance. Show the host explanation. When presentation.previousSoundRevision is present, include presentation.nextLink as the previous playable version. Offer the user the choice to refine it. Do not retry the model or invent a link. A validated proposal includes a host-authored trialOffer: tell the user it is free in the browser without an install or account, and include its actual trialOffer.playerUrl immediately, even when the user never asked for a link. A separate request for a public snapshot can use open_sound. It does not publish a sound, start audio or generate audio files. Use open_sound separately after the user chooses public sharing.
